modules.module_title: Preparation of ginned cotton for pressing operations

pcs.pc_description: check if the machines and materials used are free from faults prior to production work as per the SOP
maintain prescribed moisture level such as temperature, humidity, etc. throughout the ginning process
set up the lint processing arrangements of the machine according to manufacturers instructions and production requirements
set the machine controls as per requirements of the materials
follow instructions received from in-charge about the tasks to be performed as per the SOP
use prescribed tools and equipment for machine set up
start and stop machinery in accordance with safety measures
report faults in the materials or machines used to the assigned in-charge

modules.module_title: Carry out pressing and packaging of bales

pcs.pc_description: operate allotted bale pressing machine in accordance with SOP
troubleshoot bale pressing machines within limits of responsibility
clean bale pressing machine parts and components as per the limits of responsibility
operate pneumatic conveyor system to transport lint from gin house to pressing machine
set the bale pressing machine pressure as per bale size requirement
release the pressure of bale press machine pistons as per the instructions
put metal or synthetic green tapes on the bales as per the SOP
join loose end of each synthetic tape with prescribed tools
pack the bale with prescribed cotton cloth as per the packing instruction
stick labels on the bales mentioning the batch number, bale number, manufacture date, weight, etc.
transfer packed bales to bales storage area with fork lift as per the SOP
cover the pressed cotton bale with given tarpaulin sheet to protect it from dust, heat, water, etc.
monitor the passage of feed material into allotted the bale pressing machine
set up bale tie feed systems in accordance with the manufacturing procedures
report abnormalities and deviations to the supervisor as per the SOP
complete forms, records, and reports as per the SOP
